classes.A+D: mixed table; split by row predicate

conventions.time: vendor datetime = site-local, no tz; convert with tenant tz to UTC
conventions.money: vendor numeric(p,s) -> invariant decimal string -> PG numeric
conventions.never_sync_note: never_sync binds capture: these columns are never selected into a batch. One reader outside capture: the staff sync (ADR 0101) reads CashierDef.TouchID on the store machine only to send HMAC(K_t, pin), never the PIN; PassWord and CardID are never read.
conventions.pda_owned_storage: Class E tables live in SQLite %ProgramData%\MM-PDA\pda.db (ADR/P6b), not SQL Server
